PersonalAccount._Comment: Regex matching personal/human accounts to exclude from the AD service account list.

PersonalSafe._Comment: Regex matching personal safe names in CyberArk. Accounts stored in these safes are excluded from the CyberArk service-account count and cross-reference.

EmployeeFilter._Comment: Accounts with nIEMPTYPE matching any EmployeeTypes AND having a non-empty EmployeeID are treated as employee accounts and excluded.

ServiceAccountAnalysis._Comment_Domains: List of domains to scan for Service Accounts. ExcludeOUs: list of OU distinguished names to skip during AD query (e.g. 'OU=ServiceAccounts_Disabled,DC=na,DC=company,DC=com').

Notifications._Comment_AdminTo: Admin alert recipients for summary email
Notifications._Comment_SendSimulationSummary: If true, sends a summary email at the end of a run
